# NaijaPrice Tracker

> Interactive Nigerian agricultural commodity price analytics, seasonality decomposition, multi-model forecasting, SQLite watchlists, threshold deviation alerts, and exportable PDF market intelligence briefs.

NaijaPrice Tracker helps Nigerian agro-traders, researchers, and students evaluate wholesale/retail Naira (NGN) commodity trajectories across six regional hubs (Mile 12 Lagos, Dawanau Kano, Bodija Ibadan, Wuse Abuja, Relief Market Aba, and Terminus Market Jos) using a Python analytics engine.

## Core Workspace Views

- [Commodity Price Trajectory & Forecasting](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/price-forecast): Analyze spot prices, 12-month moving averages, and 3-to-12 month forecast intervals across Nigerian markets.
- [Personalized Watchlists & Deviation Alerts](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/watchlists): Monitor custom combinations of Nigerian commodities and markets with SQLite-backed threshold alerts.
- [Nigerian Commodity Seasonality Matrix](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/seasonality-matrix): Compare harvest gluts and lean-season price peaks across 12 calendar months for staple crops.
- [Cross-Market Arbitrage & Transport Margin Calculator](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/market-arbitrage): Identify origin-to-destination price spreads across Lagos, Kano, Ibadan, Abuja, Aba, and Jos markets.
- [Market Price Data Ledger & CSV Survey Import](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/data-ledger): Browse 2,784 monthly Nigerian market observations or upload local field survey CSV prices.
- [Commodity Intelligence Briefs, PDF Export & Python Source](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/reports-python): Download formal PDF market intelligence briefs, forecast CSVs, and the standalone Streamlit/Pandas/Scikit-learn script.

## Tracked Commodities (2022–2026 Monthly Series)

- Rice (Local Ofada) — 50kg bag (Grains & Cereals)
- Garri (White) — 50kg bag (Tubers & Processed)
- Beans (Oloyin Brown) — 100kg bag (Legumes)
- Maize (Yellow) — 100kg bag (Grains & Cereals)
- Tomatoes (Fresh) — 45kg basket (Perishables)
- Yam (Puna / White) — 100kg bundle (Tubers & Processed)
- Palm Oil — 25L jerrycan (Oils & Fats)
- Onions (Red Sokoto) — 100kg bag (Perishables)

## Quantitative Methodology

- **Seasonal Decomposition**: Centered 12-month moving-average multiplicative decomposition identifying harvest gluts and lean-season peaks.
- **Forecasting Models**: Ridge Linear + Seasonal Dummies, Polynomial + Fourier Harmonics, and Multiplicative Holt-Winters with 6-month holdout backtesting (MAE, RMSE, MAPE).
- **Alerts & Persistence**: SQLite-backed custom watchlists and threshold alerts comparing spot prices against trailing 12-month averages, OLS trendlines, and all-time means.

## Machine-Readable & Export Resources

- [XML Sitemap](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL index for all application routes.
- [Historical Commodity Dataset CSV](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/api/export/dataset): 2,784 monthly NGN observations (Jan 2022–Oct 2026).
- [Standalone Streamlit App (Python)](https://ais-dev-o6pm3tgzkbaidkcj3kkj5h-561724815819.europe-west1.run.app/api/export/streamlit): Portable Pandas, Plotly, and Scikit-learn companion script.
